title: CTI RAG Poisoning Benchmark: code and results for "Rank Placement Is Not Displacement"
description:
Deterministic, zero-cost benchmark of retrieval-layer robustness to corpus poisoning in cyber threat intelligence (CTI) retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). It compares four retrieval architectures (lexical BM25, dense bi-encoder, hybrid fusion with cross-encoder reranking and entity-graph traversal) on a 24,000-document corpus built from MITRE ATT&CK, CTIBench, CISA KEV and the CVE Program, with 150 queries in three strata, nine attack vectors and budgets of one to five payloads.

The archive contains the code and the complete outputs of the runs reported in the article: the main run v3, the control re-run v2_rerun (original question templates) and the archived run v2, including per-query traces with full score-tie groups, the bridge-count sweep and the McNemar analysis.
